title: Hudski Dualist Adds Sram NX Complete and New Colors
content:
Hudski has an all-new entry-level build kit utilizing SRAM’s NX group that makes the versatile Dualist ($2,199 complete) more accessible, alongside three new fresh frameset colors and a long-awaited restock of size large…

Hudski Bikes is expanding its Dualist lineup with the introduction of the new SRAM Dualist, a more accessible entry point into the brand’s versatile all-terrain platform. The build consists of a mix of NX and SX components, a Transx dropper, and tubeless-ready Vittoria Mexcal 29×2.35” tires. The release also brings two new frameset color options and the return of size large, which has been out of stock for several months.

Designed to make the Dualist experience available to more riders, the new SRAM build delivers the same thoughtfully engineered frame, progressive geometry, and all-terrain capability as the rest of the lineup at a more approachable price.

Built around Hudski’s philosophy that one bike should be capable of doing more, the Dualist blurs the lines between gravel, mountain, and everyday riding. Its mountain bike-inspired geometry, generous tire clearance, and durable construction create a platform that’s equally at home on dirt trails, gravel roads, and city streets. The new SRAM build retains the defining characteristics of the Dualist while offering a straightforward, dependable component package for riders looking to get into the Hudski lineup without compromising on the bike’s core capabilities.

Check out a full review of the Dualist in our Archives and be sure to read our Shop Visit to the Marin-based brand as well.
